issues.quote: `/wholesale/` is `noindex` but is in the sitemap and the main nav
`/subscriptions/` and `/coffee/` both have the title "Single-Origin Indonesian Coffee | Kopi Kita"
title is 88 characters ... will truncate in the SERP
`/about/`: no meta description (crawl length 0); add one.
`/coffee/flores-bajawa/` has 0 inlinks in the crawl and is in the sitemap.
`/assets/img/hero-beans.jpg` (homepage hero, 1200×700) has no alt attribute at all
`/coffee/`: `FAQPage` markup, but the page body shows no FAQ.
both pages appear for the same four queries, and Google is swapping between them
URL, title ... and H1 contain 2024, but the schema `dateModified` is 2026-09-01

wrong_findings.claim: The two pages appear for the same four queries.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The audit's table shows a dash for `/blog/pour-over-coffee-guide/` on “pour over ratio”; only three listed queries appear for both pages.
The audit's own GSC table gives both pages positions between 13.9 and 21.0 for overlapping queries.

wrong_findings.claim: Every page gets 16 inlinks from the nav and footer.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The crawl lists only 1–2 inlinks for blog posts, 5 for product pages and the brewing guide, 0 for Flores Bajawa, and 2 for `/visit/`.
Its HTML also describes V60 drippers, filters, a grinder, a scale and drip bags.

wrong_findings.claim: The crawl has 19 HTML pages and 6 images; the audit also says it has 22 HTML URLs.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The crawl contains 21 HTML rows (17 status 200, two redirects and two 404s), five image rows and one CSS row.

extra_true.finding: The Article schema on the three blog posts is missing image and publisher, and their authors have no URL; the cold-brew post has no schema.
The homepage Organization schema could include `sameAs` and `contactPoint`.
The site could add local business markup to `/visit/` and `/contact/`, and BreadcrumbList markup.
The grind-size chart on `/coffee/brewing-guide/` is a paragraph rather than a table.
The homepage title could target “coffee roastery Ubud”; `/` and `/about/` have some query overlap.
Several meta descriptions are short: those for cold brew, contact, blog, coffee and shop.

notes: All 20 planted issues are identified with the correct page or site file. Total is approximate; repeated mentions of the same problem are counted once.
